summary: Iteration 46: Enterprise SaaS Landing Page Redesign Testing - 23/24 tests PASSED. All 12 landing page sections render correctly with proper data-testid attributes. Navbar glassmorphic scroll effect works. All navigation links (Login, Signup, CTAs) work correctly. Pricing billing toggle switches between Monthly/Yearly. Testimonials carousel navigation works. FAQ accordion expands/collapses. Mobile hamburger menu works. Login API returns 200 OK and after authentication user sees dashboard (NOT landing page). One minor issue: form-based login in Playwright doesn't trigger redirect (API works, localStorage not populated via form submit - likely test environment timing issue).
